summary: DNR camping/park pages, ExploreMoreIL (all 96 units of Chief Keokuk) and the 2027 fee PDF read. 70 Class A electric pads (30 A, 50 A at 17), no water/sewer at sites, all back-in, mostly 30-ft pads (four at 40); 25 walk-in tent sites. 2027 Electric $28 (stored 28 kept; reservation fee cleared). Open year-round for dry camping: water/showers/dump and sites 1-31 close Nov 1 - May 1, plus an early-November hunt closure. Booking operator -> usedirect #!park/32, fcfs some_sites. Waterfront lakeview -> not waterfront recommended. Phone 309-853-2425 (none stored).
flags: WATERFRONT: recommend lakeview -> not waterfront. Engine unit points put the nearest Class A pads (9 at 41.32576,-89.88743; 10 at 41.32595,-89.88722; 11; 12) about 100-130 m from Johnson Lake's west shore (lake reached near 41.3248,-89.8865), through continuous forest canopy on the summer imagery, and about 11 m above the water (3DEP 228 m at site 9 vs 217 m on the lake). No pad has an open sightline. The stored evidence's 'partly open slope with water line of sight' is not visible; the other loops (32-72) are 300 m+ west.
